name: SRLINES Ultimate 6-in-1 Google Maps AI Lead Pipeline

parameters.jsCode: function clean(v){return(v??'').toString().trim()}function phone(v){return clean(v).replace(/[\s().-]/g,'')}function dom(url){try{return new URL(url.startsWith('http')?url:'https://'+url).hostname.replace(/^www\./,'').toLowerCase()}catch{return''}}return items.map(item=>{const j=item.json;const email=clean(j.email||j.emails?.[0]||'').toLowerCase();const website=clean(j.website||j.url||j.site||'');return{json:{...j,businessName:clean(j.name||j.title||j.businessName||j.placeName),email,phone:phone(j.phone||j.telephone),website,domain:dom(website),city:clean(j.city||j.keywordCity),industry:clean(j.industry||j.keywordIndustry),rating:Number(j.rating||0),reviews:Number(String(j.reviews||j.reviewCount||0).replace(/\D/g,''))||0,normalizedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}}).filter(i=>i.json.businessName&&i.json.email);

async function fetchText(url){try{return await this.helpers.httpRequest({url,method:'GET',timeout:15000,headers:{'User-Agent':'SRLINES lead research bot'},json:false})}catch{return''}}const out=[];for(const item of items){const j=item.json;let html='';if(j.website)html=await fetchText.call(this,j.website);const text=String(html).replace(/<script[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi,' ').replace(/<style[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,12000);const lower=(text+' '+j.website).toLowerCase();out.push({json:{...j,websiteText:text,signals:{hasWebsite:!!j.website,hasCompanyEmail:!!j.email&&!/@(gmail|yahoo|hotmail|outlook)\./i.test(j.email),usesGmail:/@(gmail|yahoo|hotmail|outlook)\./i.test(j.email),shopify:/cdn\.shopify|myshopify|shopify/i.test(html),whatsapp:/wa\.me|api\.whatsapp|whatsapp/i.test(html),facebook:/facebook\.com|fb\.com/i.test(html),instagram:/instagram\.com/i.test(html),ecommerce:/cart|checkout|shopify|woocommerce|add to cart/i.test(lower)}}})}return out;

function h(j){let s=0;if(j.signals.shopify)s+=30;if(j.signals.hasWebsite)s+=20;if(j.signals.hasCompanyEmail)s+=15;if(j.signals.facebook)s+=5;if(j.signals.instagram)s+=5;if(j.reviews>100)s+=10;if(j.signals.usesGmail)s-=5;if(!j.signals.hasWebsite)s-=50;if(!j.email)s=-999;return Math.max(0,Math.min(100,s))}const cfg=$('Runtime Config').first().json;const out=[];for(const item of items){const j=item.json;const base=h(j);let ai={score:base,priority:base>=85?'Hot':base>=70?'Warm':'Low',pain_points:[],crm:'Unknown',shopify:!!j.signals.shopify,industry:j.industry};try{const key=cfg.deepseek.apiKey;if(!key||key==='PASTE_DEEPSEEK_API_KEY_HERE')throw new Error('Configure cfg.deepseek.apiKey in Runtime Config');const prompt=`Evaluate this Pakistani B2B lead for SRLINES. Return only JSON with score, priority, industry, employees, crm, shopify, pain_points, personalization_angle. Lead: ${JSON.stringify({businessName:j.businessName,city:j.city,industry:j.industry,email:j.email,website:j.website,rating:j.rating,reviews:j.reviews,signals:j.signals,websiteText:j.websiteText?.slice(0,4000)})}`;const res=await this.helpers.httpRequest({method:'POST',url:cfg.deepseek.apiUrl,headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${key}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:{model:cfg.deepseek.model,temperature:.35,messages:[{role:'user',content:prompt}],response_format:{type:'json_object'}},json:true,timeout:120000});ai={...ai,...JSON.parse(res.choices?.[0]?.message?.content||'{}')}}catch(e){ai.error=e.message}const finalScore=Math.round(Math.max(base,Number(ai.score)||0));out.push({json:{...j,aiAnalysis:ai,score:finalScore,priority:ai.priority||(finalScore>=85?'Hot':finalScore>=70?'Warm':'Low'),qualified:finalScore>=cfg.limits.minScoreToEmail}})}return out;

const cfg=$('Runtime Config').first().json;const ms=(cfg.limits.minDelaySeconds+Math.random()*(cfg.limits.maxDelaySeconds-cfg.limits.minDelaySeconds))*1000;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));return items;

## 1. Lead Discovery
Cron → config → AI keywords → Google Maps scraping.

## 4. Reply & Bounce Sync
Runs from Runtime Config on every execution. Gmail reply search appends Reply_Log; Gmail bounce search appends Blacklist. These tabs are checked before initial and follow-up sends.
